reflection_prompts.question: What is one small, quiet moment from this past week that made you feel peaceful, even for just ten seconds?
What is a burden or expectation you have been carrying today that is not yours to hold alone?
If your 80-year-old self walked through the door of this café right now, what comforting advice would they give you?
What simple joy did you love unconditionally as a child that you haven't given yourself time for lately?
